name: 14445 · E Rochester, NY
findings: ZIP 14445 (E Rochester) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14445 (E Rochester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14445 (E Rochester) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
